verdict.rationale: Riskified is a fraud-decisioning platform, so passing verified AI-agent identity into the risk decision is a fair axis. The evidence pack has no mention of agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, or delegated spending scopes as order-payload fields or decision signals. The HMAC request signing in the docs authenticates the merchant's API calls, not agents. The Agentforce Commerce item is only a renamed Salesforce e-commerce platform cartridge.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass verified agent identity — agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, delegated spending scopes — into the risk decision as a first-class signal
